## Observation datasets

### beryllium\_lazicki\_2012\_table2\_he\_compression

- **Description:** All 41 hcp-Be pressure/lattice observations from the three helium runs in Lazicki et al. (2012), version-of-record Table II.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Lazicki; Dewaele; Loubeyre; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2012
    - **Title:** High-pressure–temperature phase diagram and the equation of state of beryllium
    - **Source:** Physical Review B
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.86.174118
- **Source location:** APS version of record, Table II
- **Associated EOS records:** beryllium\_hcp\_dewaele\_2019\_mao\_vinet; beryllium\_hcp\_dewaele\_2019\_dor\_vinet
- **Notes:** The APS version of record is the numerical authority. Its 24.6 GPa Be+He\_3 row prints a=2.162 A; the earlier OSTI accepted manuscript prints a=2.262 A. Both tokens are preserved explicitly, and the fit uses only the version-of-record column. Atomic volume is derived as sqrt(3)\*a^2\*c/4 per atom. Dewaele (2019), Section 4, confirms that the original Be pressures use the Dorogokupets--Oganov scale.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/beryllium-lazicki-2012-table2-he-compression.csv)
